title: Google Cloud Launches Gemini Agent, Enters the Enterprise AI Office Market Bravely
excerpt: At the recent 2026 Google Cloud Gemini at Work conference, Google Cloud officially launched a general-purpose AI agent product for enterprise users - Gemini Age
content_html:
At the recent 2026 Google Cloud Gemini at Work conference, Google Cloud officially launched a general-purpose AI agent product for enterprise users - Gemini Agent. The release of this product marks Google Cloud's full entry into the AI office market, aiming to provide enterprises with digital colleagues capable of highly autonomous execution.

As a fully functional enterprise-level AI agent, Gemini Agent allows users to input work objectives through simple natural language. Subsequently, the system can autonomously break down tasks, call scattered enterprise data, write and run code, generate multiple types of content, and even organize multiple sub-agents to work collaboratively. Users do not need to provide step-by-step instructions throughout the process; they only need to check progress, adjust requirements, or authorize core operations at key points.

In terms of core technology and architecture, this product has several breakthrough advantages:

Intelligent Routing and Cost Optimization: Supports a multi-model intelligent routing mechanism, reducing the overall operating cost to one-third of that of cutting-edge models while improving operating speed by 40%.

Fourfold Memory Mechanism: Effectively reduces the communication cost of repeatedly explaining background information in long-term collaboration.

Vertical Industry Versions: Launches specialized versions for the finance and legal industries, accurately matching specific industry compliance and business needs.

Comprehensive Security Governance System: Establishes a complete enterprise governance framework including identity auditing, execution isolation, traffic control, and real-time spending limits, ensuring the safety and controllability of the AI agent's autonomous operation.

Currently, Gemini Agent has not announced specific commercial dates or pricing plans and is only available for preview to selected enterprise users. With continuous competition from similar products such as Doubao Work, Tencent WorkBuddy, and Alibaba Qwen Office, Google Cloud still needs to further validate its actual performance in areas such as permission management and cross-system integration in production environments in the future.
